xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4480: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 9): pan share and pan join CLI

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 9): pan share and pan join CLI
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue requires the two verbs, their wrapper skills in the same change (scripts/lint-skills.sh fails otherwise), the share Worker invite-page line, the drift-gated composer manifest, a zero-install cold-start test and the docs. That spans src/lib, src/dashboard, src/cli, tests/unit, tests/integration, services/share, sync-sources, packages/contracts and the doc roots, 25 files in all. Splitting the invite page or the skills into sibling issues would ship a page naming a command that does not exist, or verbs that fail lint:skills. PRD D-13.

narratives.Problem: Shared Sessions slices 1-4 let a host share a conversation from the dashboard and a viewer join from the browser, but there is no terminal path. The invite page tells a joiner to run pan up, which needs tmux and a global install, so a person who never installed Overdeck cannot join at all. The operator requires npx @overdeck/core join <code> to work cold on a machine with only Node 22.
narratives.Proposal: Add a lazy command group with two verbs. pan share <conversation> resolves the conversation, calls POST /api/shares on the running dashboard with the internal token, and prints the join link and the join code (BCDF-GHJK) plus both join commands. pan join <link-or-code> parses the target, runs the existing device flow (loginCommand) when account.json is missing, starts the bundled dashboard server detached when nothing answers on the local API URL (modelled on pan serve, not pan up), posts the join intent, polls until the join leaves connecting, and opens <apiUrl>/#/shared/<CODE> where the existing page subscribes to the live join and shows the lobby. Short-code parsers move to a leaf module so the CLI never imports dashboard routes. The share Worker invite page gains pan join <CODE> and npx @overdeck/core join <CODE>. Wrapper skills, the regenerated composer manifest, a slow cold-start integration test and the docs ship in the same change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No pan share list, pan share end, or admit/kick/revoke from the CLI; the dashboard share dialog owns them.
- pan share never auto-starts a dashboard.
- No hosted web join (PAN-4481) and no pan:// protocol handler.
- pan join does not hold the join event stream and does not render the conversation in the terminal.
- No change to /api/shares*, /api/joins*, the room reducer, share-host.ts or share-join.ts behavior, and no new dashboard HTTP route.
- Auto-start does not support dashboard.require_token_mint: true without an existing browser session.
- No change to pan serve or pan up.
- No change to the package.json bin map.

autoDecisions.summary: pan join auto-starts the bundled dashboard the way pan serve does (detached spawn of dist/dashboard/server.js under process.execPath, log to dashboard.log, wait for /api/health from the spawned PID), not through pan up.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan up makes a missing tmux fatal, refuses non-primary cwds and starts Herdr/Traefik/Electron; a viewer needs none of that, and the zero-install requirement forbids needing tmux or Herdr. A later pan up replaces the auto-started server because stopDashboard frees the ports by PID.

autoDecisions.summary: The documented no-install command is npx @overdeck/core join <CODE>.
autoDecisions.rationale: npm 10.9.4 libnpmexec get-bin-from-manifest.js runs a multi-bin package when every bin value is the same file; package.json maps overdeck and pan to ./dist/cli/index.js. The issue also reports npx -y @overdeck/core --version working.

autoDecisions.summary: pan share requires a running dashboard and exits 1 with 'Start it with pan up' when none answers.
autoDecisions.rationale: The host WebRTC hub lives in the full dashboard stack next to the conversation's terminal session; a bare auto-started server is the wrong host.

autoDecisions.summary: pan join reuses loginCommand unchanged for sign-in instead of a new device-flow wrapper.
autoDecisions.rationale: loginCommand already prints the device-flow lines, exits on failure and handles slow_down through pollForToken; reuse keeps one sign-in path.

autoDecisions.summary: The CLI posts the join intent itself through callDashboard with the internal token, then opens /#/shared/<CODE> without any token in the URL.
autoDecisions.rationale: Internal-token credentials skip CSRF by design; the PAN-4475 PRD names pan join as a join-intent sender; useSharedJoin subscribes to a live join without posting; appending overdeck_token to the hash would corrupt the #/shared route and loopback browsers mint sessions without it.

autoDecisions.summary: pan join polls GET /api/joins/<code> every 500 ms for at most 15 s while connecting, then maps the state to a message; terminal states exit 1 without opening a browser.
autoDecisions.rationale: A wrong or ended code resolves to ended within that window, so the user gets a terminal answer instead of an error page; live states open the lobby.

autoDecisions.summary: --no-open prints the URL and does not hold the event stream.
autoDecisions.rationale: A join with no subscriber becomes away after 60 s and the page re-posts an away join on load, so holding the stream adds code without changing the outcome.

autoDecisions.summary: pan share takes a required <conversation> argument (numeric id or name) and adds --json; pan join adds only --no-open.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names pan share <conversationId>; numeric-or-name resolution matches pan handoff; --json gives skills and scripts a stable output; --no-open covers headless machines and the cold-start test.

autoDecisions.summary: The zero-install acceptance is proven by a slow integration test that runs the built CLI's join in temp HOME/OVERDECK_HOME with tmux, herdr and pan shadowed by exit-127 stubs, plus manual npm pack + npx evidence in the PR body.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI cannot run a real npx install from the registry; running dist/cli/index.js from an unrelated cwd with only config.yaml in the home exercises the same code path, and the packed-tarball run is recorded by the test role.

autoDecisions.summary: normalizeShareCode and parseJoinTarget move to src/lib/sharing/share-code.ts; the route modules re-export them.
autoDecisions.rationale: The CLI must not import dashboard route modules (Effect HTTP router, share managers); re-exports keep the existing route tests unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: The auto-started dashboard boots with agent auto-resume off: env goes through applyBootGateEnv(env, { resume: false }) from src/lib/boot-gates.ts, so OVERDECK_NO_RESUME=1; the Deacon gate keeps its default.
autoDecisions.rationale: Joining a share must not resume an installed user's stopped agent fleet as a side effect; an explicit no-resume fast-paths boot reconciliation to hold_all, and a later pan up restores the user's normal gates. PRD D-14.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/cli/commands/sharing/local-dashboard.ts exporting DASHBOARD_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000, DASHBOARD_START_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000, LocalDashboardError, LocalDashboard { apiUrl, started, pid }, LocalDashboardDeps { fetch, spawn, apiUrl, waitForHealth, packageRoot }, ensureLocalDashboard(deps) and openDashboardUrl(url) (openBrowser from src/lib/browser.ts provided with @effect/platform-node/NodeServices layer, as serve.ts openServeUrlInBrowser does). Heavy modules load by dynamic import inside functions. Steps: resolve apiUrl (deps.apiUrl ?? getDashboardApiUrl from src/lib/config.ts), probe GET <apiUrl>/api/health with AbortController + setTimeout(2_000) (never AbortSignal.timeout); any HTTP response means running -> {started:false}. On fetch failure require http: + hostname localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] + explicit port, else throw LocalDashboardError('No Overdeck dashboard answers at <apiUrl>. Start it with pan up.'). Require <packageRoot>/dist/dashboard/server.js and public/index.html else throw 'Dashboard bundle not found in ...'. ensureInternalToken(); mkdir -p getOverdeckHome(); spawn(process.execPath, [server], { detached: true, cwd: getOverdeckHome(), stdio: openDashboardLogStdio(), env: applyBootGateEnv({ ...process.env minus DASHBOARD_URL and OVERDECK_DASHBOARD_URL, PORT, API_PORT, OVERDECK_MODE: 'production' }, { resume: false }) (PRD D-14, so OVERDECK_NO_RESUME=1) }); child.unref(). Race waitForHealth(port, pid) (default waitForDashboardHealth from src/lib/platform-lifecycle.ts with timeoutMs 120_000 and expectedPid) against child 'exit' and 'error'; map each to the LocalDashboardError messages in PRD WI-2, naming DASHBOARD_LOG_FILE; never kill the child. No execSync. Tests per PRD WI-2 with fake fetch, fake spawn (EventEmitter with pid and unref), temp packageRoot and OVERDECK_HOME, vi.useFakeTimers(). Implementation checkpoint: if the cold-start test shows the bundled server hard-failing without tmux/Herdr, fix that boot step to log and continue; if larger than one function, pan tell flywheel-orchestrator with the log lines.
